name: APIVerveRhymingWords
summary: Rhyming Words finds matching rhymes for any query word, returning a list of rhyming words and a total match count.
description:
Rhyming Words finds matching rhymes for any query word, returning a list of rhyming words and a total match count. Paid plans can adjust the maximum number of rhymes returned.

This iOS/macOS SDK provides a convenient way to access the Rhyming Words from APIVerve.
Supports both callback-based and async/await patterns.
